stories.title: Police reveal what happened before child fell from SUV in west Houston
stories.summary: An 8-year-old boy is critically injured after falling from a moving SUV in Houston; his father, Oscar Pereira Bustill, faces felony DWI charges, court records show.

stories.title: Popular restaurants at Houston's Bush Airport closing their doors
stories.summary: "We are grateful to our employees and the millions of travelers who have dined with us over the years," the company said.

stories.title: 2 dead in northeast Houston house fire were beloved members of the community, family says
stories.summary: The Houston Police Department confirmed its homicide division is investigating two deaths at the scene, but did not release any additional details.

stories.title: Houston SuperFeast organizers make urgent plea for Thanksgiving food donations
